summary: Dr. Dasyam Pallavi is a consultant in pain management at Halcyon Pain Management Centre in Kukatpally, Hyderabad. She holds the Certified Interventional Pain Sonologist (CIPS) credential awarded by the World Institute of Pain (WIP), USA, and is a Fellow of the Indian Academy of Pain Medicine (FIAPM). Her clinical work centres on ultrasound-guided pain interventions for musculoskeletal and nerve pain.

sections.h2: International certification in ultrasound-guided pain interventions
paragraphs: Dr. Dasyam Pallavi holds the Certified Interventional Pain Sonologist (CIPS) credential awarded by the World Institute of Pain (WIP), USA.

CIPS is an international certification focused specifically on ultrasound-guided interventional pain procedures. It is not simply a course-completion certificate: the credential is awarded after successfully completing the World Institute of Pain’s structured examination process, which includes written, oral and practical, cadaver-based assessment.

The certification assesses a physician’s knowledge of the relevant anatomy and sonoanatomy, together with the practical application of ultrasound in interventional pain procedures. It is a specialised international credential held by a comparatively limited group of physicians who have completed the World Institute of Pain’s certification process.

Many modern pain procedures can be performed under real-time ultrasound guidance, which lets the physician see the relevant nerves, muscles, tendons, joints and surrounding structures while performing the intervention.

A CIPS-certified physician has undergone a dedicated international assessment in the use of ultrasound for interventional pain procedures. This is particularly relevant to procedures involving peripheral nerves, joints and musculoskeletal structures.

Dr. Pallavi is also a Fellow of the Indian Academy of Pain Medicine (FIAPM), reflecting dedicated training and professional development in the assessment and management of patients with acute and chronic pain conditions.

faqs.q: What is a Certified Interventional Pain Sonologist (CIPS)?
faqs.a: CIPS is an international credential from the World Institute of Pain (WIP), USA, focused on ultrasound-guided interventional pain procedures. It is awarded after a structured examination with written, oral and practical, cadaver-based assessment of anatomy, sonoanatomy and the use of ultrasound during procedures.

faqs.q: What does Dr. Dasyam Pallavi specialise in?
faqs.a: Ultrasound-guided pain interventions: musculoskeletal ultrasound, peripheral nerve interventions, radiofrequency procedures, joint and periarticular interventions, and the management of chronic musculoskeletal pain. Treatment is individualised after clinical assessment and a review of your investigations.
FIAPM means Fellow of the Indian Academy of Pain Medicine. It reflects dedicated training and professional development in assessing and managing patients with acute and chronic pain conditions.

faqs.q: Is Dr. Pallavi a registered medical practitioner?
faqs.a: Yes. Dr. Dasyam Pallavi is registered with the Telangana State Medical Council, registration number 61959.

faqs.q: How do I book an appointment with Dr. Pallavi?
faqs.a: Call +91 77880 91092. The clinic is open Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 6 pm, at the 3rd floor of the KKR Commercial Complex, Kukatpally Y Junction, Hyderabad. Bring any recent X-ray, MRI or ultrasound reports and a list of your medicines.
